metadata.name: glance_vault
metadata.description: Glance vault: policy-bound delegated stock buys on Solana

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Two-step admin rotation, step 2: the proposed key proves control by signing.

instructions.name: allow_mint
docs: Curate one stock mint, with its issuer rule. Checked now as well as at every swap: a
mint that does not already carry the required delegate is refused.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Anyone may deposit a stable mint into a vault (gifts, top-ups). Destination is fixed to the vault's ATA.

accounts.name: vault_ata
docs: ATA address is deterministic and the ATA program fixes owner = vault, so init_if_needed cannot be poisoned.

instructions.name: disallow_mint
docs: Remove a mint from the catalog. Vaults keep what they hold and can still withdraw it;
the agent can no longer buy or sell it.

instructions.name: execute_swap_desk
docs: OTC fill: vault pays `amount_in` of the input mint to the desk, the desk pays
`amount_out` of the output mint into the vault's ATA. Both the agent and the
desk sign, so the price is agreed by two independent keys; the vault enforces
direction, curation, caps, and that its own account is the destination.

accounts.name: agent
docs: The delegated signer. Also pays rent for the vault's output ATA on first use.

accounts.name: desk
docs: The config-approved counterparty. Must co-sign: it is giving up tokens.

accounts.name: allowed_mint
docs: The stock side's AllowedMint (the output on a buy, the input on a sell); checked in the handler.

accounts.name: vault_out
docs: Destination is structurally the vault's own ATA (spec §8.3 check 4).

instructions.name: execute_swap_router
docs: Router fill (Jupiter on mainnet). `route_data` is the router instruction data built
off-chain; `remaining_accounts` are the router's accounts in order. The vault PDA is
the only signer we extend into the CPI; every other remaining account must be a
non-signer, and no vault-owned token account other than vault_in/vault_out may be
handed to the router.

accounts.name: allowed_mint
docs: The stock side's AllowedMint; checked in the handler.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: One-time config creation. Only the program's upgrade authority may call it, which
closes the classic "anyone initializes the global config first" race after deploy.

accounts.name: program
docs: Anti-frontrun: only the upgrade authority may create the config.

instructions.name: initialize_vault
docs: Onboarding in one signature (spec §7.2): create the vault, set policy + agent,
create the vault's stable-mint ATA and deposit the initial amount.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Instant and unconditional (spec §8.2).

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Two-step admin rotation, step 1.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Owner withdraws any token the vault holds, to the owner's own ATA. No timelock: Glance never gates access to funds.

types.name: AllowedMint
docs: One curated stock mint and its issuer rule, at ["allowed", mint].

fields.name: issuer_delegate
docs: The Token-2022 PermanentDelegate the mint must carry, or None when admin curation is the only gate.

fields.name: desk
docs: OTC counterparty for `execute_swap_desk`. Pubkey::default() disables the desk path.

fields.name: router_program
docs: Router for `execute_swap_router` (Jupiter on mainnet). Pubkey::default() disables it.

fields.name: issuer_authorities
docs: Legacy (v1): no longer read by swaps, which use each mint's AllowedMint issuer rule.
Kept so the deployed Config account keeps its layout.

fields.name: allowed_mints
docs: Legacy (v1): no longer read by swaps, which require the mint's AllowedMint account.
Kept so the deployed Config account keeps its layout.

fields.name: max_agent_ttl_secs
docs: Upper bound on `agent_expires_at - now` (seconds).

fields.name: agent_expires_at
docs: unix seconds; 0 when no agent

fields.name: per_tx_cap
docs: stable base units (USDC: 6 dp)

fields.name: daily_window_start
docs: unix seconds; rolling window start
